invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null List created via collect(Collectors.toList()).
File IDs are extracted via getFileId() and should not be null.
File IDs are collected using .distinct(), so the result must be free of duplicates.
The method uses partitionPath as an argument; a null value might cause an exception.
The result is always a List as per the return type and collect(Collectors.toList()).
